get.summary:
Measure detail for a session year (current or historical). 
Optional specialSession selects legacy `splsession…` published content (letter suffix rules; see API docs).

All measures for a special session: looked up in `dbo.Table_SpecialSession_Measure` on the
primary reporting catalog, keyed by the `ss_year` token (e.g. `2024a`, `2021b`).
Falls back to scanning published PDFs under the `splsession…` folder when SQL returns no rows
or the table is unavailable.

Bearer.description: JWT from POST /connect/token (grant_type=client_credentials, scope=api). Paste only the access_token value.
